# GitLab Standard

## Purpose

Define organization-wide expectations for GitLab-based delivery and automation.

## Scope

- Applies to GitLab workflow design and review.
- Describes organizational expectations for pipeline structure and governance.
- Leaves job-specific details to profiles, modules, or skills.

## Ownership

- Primary owner: delivery platform maintainers.
- Reviewers: engineering and platform stakeholders.

## Review Process

- Keep guidance concise and reusable across pipelines.
- Avoid encoding project-specific pipeline behavior here.
- Preserve clear separation between standards and implementation detail.

## Future Content

- Pipeline governance themes.
- Review and approval expectations.
- Artifact and environment expectations.
- Delivery policy checkpoints.
